_comment: Reviewed corrections and additions applied by tools/gazetteer/build_seed.py on top of the raw Wikidata rows. Every entry states its reason; see SOURCES.md. Re-authored on 2026-09-28 after the original file was lost (it was never committed: data/ was git-ignored).

country_codes.reason: Amsterdam: the query returns no P17->P297 code for this item; capital of the Netherlands (ISO 3166-1 NL).

drop_native.reason: Malformed P1705 value: two annotated names in one string, tagged Azerbaijani.
P1705 value begins with a doubled alef (typo); it would become an Arabic endonym that matches nothing.

replace_label.reason: The hr label carries a disambiguating state qualifier; the name used in running text is New York.

The fa label carries a ', Argentina' disambiguation qualifier.
The fa label carries a ', Venezuela' disambiguation qualifier.

split_label.reason: The fa label lists two spellings, بمبئی and مومبای, joined by a slash.
